text: I usually go to the dentist at the hospital, but the last two times I asked the dentist at the hospital if I had any cavities and told him I felt sensitive. The dentist examined me and said no. After two weeks, my tooth sensitivity worsened, so I stopped by the dentist at Baan Dentist Clinic because it's close to my home. The dentist examined me thoroughly and took x-rays for clarity. They found a deep cavity and recommended a filling. The other tooth required a root canal and a crown. The dentist explained the procedure in detail. The procedure was completed within three weeks and the price was not expensive. The dentist had a very gentle touch. From now on, I'll probably go to a dentist near my home rather than going to the hospital. Thank you very much, dentist. You detected the cavity and filled it in time before I needed a root canal on the other tooth.
